```{r, Repeated Functions & Variables}
# ============================================================
# Repeated Functions
# ============================================================
# Establishing functions up front that are used throughout file

# >>>> FIGURE SAVING FUNCTION <<<<
#Saves .png and .pdf versions of a given figure
save_pdf_png = function(plot, path, w, h, u = "mm", bg = "transparent", dpi = 600) {
  for (x in c("pdf", "png")) {
    ggsave(
      plot = plot,
      filename = paste0(path, x),
      device = x,
      bg = bg,
      width = w,
      height = h,
      units = u,
      dpi = dpi
    )
  }
}

# >>>> DROPLET LOD CALCULATOR <<<<
#Calculates an estimated concentration in copies/L for a given number of droplets
droplet_LOD = function(droplets, total_droplets, V_pcr, V_e, V_r, V_w) {
  C <- -log((total_droplets - droplets)/total_droplets)/0.795
  correction <- V_pcr * V_e / V_r / V_w
  return(C*correction)
}

# >>>> SHARED PHYLOPIC ID <<
# Sunflower sea star (Pycnopodia helianthoides) silhouette from PhyloPic,
# used in both Figure 4 and Figure 5
pycno_uuid <- "be5c73aa-407f-4a6f-b7ec-6061bec99d86"

# >>>> SCIENTIFIC NOTATION AXIS LABEL FORMATTER <<
# Formats axis labels as "1.5 x 10^6" (rendered with a real superscript via
# plotmath) instead of scientific()'s "1.5e+06". 
format_sci_10 <- function(x) {
  labs <- sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return("NA")  # ggplot calls this on out-of-range breaks too; "NA" parses
                                   # fine as R code and these labels are never actually drawn
    if (val == 0) return("0")
    lab <- scales::scientific(val)             # e.g. "1.5e+06"
    lab <- gsub("e\\+?", " %*% 10^", lab)       # -> "1.5 %*% 10^06"
    lab <- gsub("\\^0+(\\d)", "^\\1", lab)      # drop leading zero in exponent
    lab <- gsub("\\^-0+(\\d)", "^-\\1", lab)    # (and for negative exponents)
    lab
  })
  parse(text = labs)
}
```

```{r, Figure Theme Configuration}
# ============================================================
# Figure Theme Configuration
# ============================================================
# Central location for all figure styling elements
# Applies to all figures in the paper for consistent appearance

# ---- TYPOGRAPHY SETTINGS ----
theme_font_sizes <- list(
  axis_tick_labels = 10,      # Axis tick labels
  legend_labels = 9,         # Legend entry labels
  axis_labels = 11,           # Axis titles
  legend_title = 11,          # Legend title
  panel_annotations = 14      # Panel labels (A, B, C, etc.)
)

# ---- BASE THEME ----
# Use this for all figures
theme_paper <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +  # base_size doesn't directly set our custom sizes
  theme(
    # Axis labels (x and y titles)
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$axis_labels),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$axis_labels),
    
    # Axis tick labels (the numbers/text on axes)
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$axis_tick_labels),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$axis_tick_labels),
    
    # Legend styling
    legend.title = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$legend_title),
    legend.text = element_text(size = theme_font_sizes$legend_labels),
    
    # Standard margins
    plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 5, t = 5, b = 5)
  )
}

# >>>> PANEL ANNOTATION FUNCTION <<<<
# Use this for all panel labels (A, B, C, etc.)
# Works with both annotate() and annotation_custom()
panel_label <- function(label, x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5) {
  annotate("text",
           x = x, y = y, label = label,
           hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust,
           size = theme_font_sizes$panel_annotations / 2.8,  # ggplot size conversion
           fontface = "bold"
  )
}

# For use with annotation_custom() (as in Figure 6)
panel_label_grob <- function(label) {
  textGrob(label,
           gp = gpar(fontsize = theme_font_sizes$panel_annotations,
                     fontface = "bold"))
}
```

```{r, ddPCR File Reading & QC Function}
# ============================================================
# ddPCR File Reading and QC Function
# ============================================================
# Establishing function for reading and checking ddPCR files

# >>>> READING ddPCR FUNCTION <<<<

# Reads in ddPCR files and performs initial quality control
read_ddpcr_files <- function(ddPCR_file_location, extraction_file_location, output_name,
                              exclude_samples = NULL,
                              exclude_wells = NULL,        # manual per-well exclusion (e.g. known pipetting errors)
                              parse_dilution = FALSE,      # parse "<id><sep><num>_<denom>" style extract_id
                              dilution_sep = " ",          # separator between id and dilution code, e.g. "3008 1_5"
                              fb_column = NULL, fb_value = "FB",
                              eb_column = "sample_id", eb_value = "EB",
                              V_pcr = 20,      # PCR reaction volume (µL)
                              V_e = 100,       # DNA extraction elution volume (µL)
                              V_r = 5,         # Template volume added to PCR (µL)
                              V_w = NULL,      # Water sample volume (L). Either:
                                               #   - a single number (same V_w for every sample - original behavior), or
                                               #   - a data frame with a join column (see V_w_join_by) and a "V_w"
                                               #     column, for files where different samples need different V_w
                                               #     (e.g. an inhibition-testing plate pulling from both the decay
                                               #     and shedding sample pools)
                              V_w_join_by = "extract_id",  # column in combined_data to join the V_w lookup on
                              add_log_transform = FALSE,  # Whether to add log10 columns
                              time_prefix = NULL,         # Prefix to remove from sampling_time (e.g., "D-", "S-")
                              min_droplets = 10000,       # Minimum accepted droplets for a well to be trusted
                              cv_threshold = 0.2) {       # CV threshold for replicate pairs

  # Initialize tracking variables
  total_samples <- 0
  total_pos_controls <- 0
  total_ntc_controls <- 0
  samples_replaced <- 0
  samples_replaced_amplification_error <- 0
  samples_replaced_pipetting_error <- 0   # NEW
  samples_failed_droplet_qc <- 0
  samples_excluded <- 0
  field_blanks <- 0
  extraction_blanks <- 0

  # ========================================
  # Dedicated environment for temp frames
  # ========================================
  # Using a private environment (instead of .GlobalEnv) means ls()/get()/assign()
  # calls below can only ever see objects this function created, so we can't
  # accidentally process or delete unrelated objects in the user's workspace,
  # and the function is safe to run multiple times in the same session.
  work_env <- new.env()

  # ========================================
  # Helper functions for console output
  # ========================================
  print_main_section <- function(title) {
    cat("\n")
    cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
    cat("║", format(title, width = 38, justify = "centre"), "║\n")
    cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
  }

  # Read in all csv files from specified location
  csv_files <- list.files(ddPCR_file_location,
                           pattern = "\\.csv$",
                           full.names = TRUE)

  walk(csv_files, function(file) {
    df_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    # Read the full data
    full_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    # Split into M wells and other wells
    m_wells <- full_data %>% filter(str_starts(Well, "M"))
    other_wells <- full_data %>% filter(!str_starts(Well, "M"))
    # Assign to separate data frames in the private work environment
    assign(paste0(df_name, "_M"), m_wells, envir = work_env)
    assign(paste0(df_name, "_other"), other_wells, envir = work_env)
  })

  cat("Imported", length(csv_files), "CSV files from", ddPCR_file_location, "\n")

  # ========================================
  # QC - Controls
  # ========================================
  print_main_section("QC - Controls")

  m_files <- ls(pattern = "_M$", envir = work_env)

  for (m_name in m_files) {
    m_df <- get(m_name, envir = work_env)

    # Count controls separately and samples from M files
    pos_controls <- m_df %>% filter(SampleType == "PosCtrl")
    ntc_controls <- m_df %>% filter(SampleType == "NTC")
    samples <- m_df %>% filter(!SampleType %in% c("PosCtrl", "NTC"))

    total_pos_controls <- total_pos_controls + nrow(pos_controls)
    total_ntc_controls <- total_ntc_controls + nrow(ntc_controls)
    total_samples <- total_samples + nrow(samples)

    # Display control info
    controls_display <- m_df %>%
      filter(SampleType %in% c("PosCtrl", "NTC")) %>%
      dplyr::select(Well, SampleType, `Conc(copies/µL)`)

    if (nrow(controls_display) > 0) {
      cat("File:", m_name, "\n")
      print(controls_display)
      cat("\n")
    }
  }

  print_main_section("QC - Positive Droplets & Replicate CV")

  other_files <- ls(pattern = "_other$", envir = work_env)

  for (other_name in other_files) {
    cat("Processing: ", other_name, "\n")
    cat("────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

    m_name <- str_replace(other_name, "_other$", "_M")
    other_df <- get(other_name, envir = work_env)
    m_df <- get(m_name, envir = work_env)

    # Track if any changes are made
    changes_made <- FALSE

    # ========================================
    # NEW: Manual exclusion of flagged wells
    # ========================================
    # For errors the automated checks below wouldn't catch (e.g. a known
    # pipetting error on one specific well). Because both replicates of a
    # sample share the same "Sample description 1", they can't be told apart
    # by sample name alone - this works off Well IDs instead, so exactly the
    # bad replicate is dropped and the good one is kept.
    #
    # exclude_wells can be:
    #   - a plain character vector of well IDs, applied to every file, or
    #   - a data frame with columns "file" (csv basename, no extension) and
    #     "well", so the same well label (e.g. "A01") on different plates
    #     isn't accidentally excluded everywhere
    if (!is.null(exclude_wells)) {
      file_label <- str_remove(other_name, "_other$")

      wells_to_drop <- if (is.data.frame(exclude_wells)) {
        exclude_wells %>% filter(file == file_label) %>% pull(well)
      } else {
        exclude_wells
      }

      flagged <- other_df %>% filter(Well %in% wells_to_drop)

      if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
        cat("Manual Exclusion (flagged wells):\n")
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(flagged))) {
          cat("  Well =", flagged$Well[i], ", Sample =",
              flagged$`Sample description 1`[i], " -> excluded\n")
        }
        cat("\n")

        affected_samples <- unique(flagged$`Sample description 1`)
        other_df <- other_df %>% filter(!Well %in% wells_to_drop)

        # If a sample had 2 replicates and now has exactly 1 left, treat that
        # surviving replicate as the merged value - same pattern used below
        # for low-droplet and high-CV replacements.
        for (sample_name in affected_samples) {
          remaining <- other_df %>% filter(`Sample description 1` == sample_name)

          if (nrow(remaining) == 1) {
            old_m_row <- m_df %>% filter(`Sample description 1` == sample_name)
            cat("  → Replacing Merged Well (", old_m_row$Well, ") with surviving Well (",
                remaining$Well[1], ") for sample ", sample_name,
                " (other replicate excluded)\n\n", sep = "")
            m_df <- rows_update(m_df, remaining[1, ], by = "Sample description 1")
            samples_replaced_pipetting_error <- samples_replaced_pipetting_error + 1
            changes_made <- TRUE
          } else if (nrow(remaining) == 0) {
            cat("  ⚠ Both replicates for sample ", sample_name,
                " were excluded - no data remains for this sample.\n\n", sep = "")
          }
        }

        assign(m_name, m_df, envir = work_env)
      }
    }

    # ========================================
    # Check for samples with insufficient droplets
    # ========================================
    # A group can end up in one of three states:
    #   (a) all replicates >= min_droplets -> no action needed
    #   (b) some replicates < min_droplets, at least one >= min_droplets
    #       -> replace the merged well with the good single replicate
    #   (c) ALL replicates < min_droplets -> nothing usable to replace with;
    #       this used to be silently dropped with no warning. Now flagged.
    droplet_groups <- other_df %>%
      group_by(`Sample description 1`) %>%
      filter(any(`Accepted Droplets` < min_droplets)) %>%
      ungroup()

    replacements <- droplet_groups %>%
      group_by(`Sample description 1`) %>%
      filter(`Accepted Droplets` >= min_droplets) %>%
      ungroup()

    fully_failed_samples <- droplet_groups %>%
      group_by(`Sample description 1`) %>%
      filter(all(`Accepted Droplets` < min_droplets)) %>%
      ungroup()

    if (nrow(replacements) > 0) {
      cat("Insufficient Droplets:\n")
      cat("Found", nrow(replacements), "sample(s) with low droplets:\n\n")
      samples_replaced <- samples_replaced + nrow(replacements)
      changes_made <- TRUE

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(replacements))) {
        sample_name <- replacements$`Sample description 1`[i]
        both_duplicates <- other_df %>% filter(`Sample description 1` == sample_name)
        old_m_row <- m_df %>% filter(`Sample description 1` == sample_name)

        cat("Sample:", sample_name, "\n")
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(both_duplicates))) {
          cat("  Well =", both_duplicates$Well[j], ", Accepted Droplets =",
              both_duplicates$`Accepted Droplets`[j], "\n")
        }
        cat("  → Replacing Merged Well (", old_m_row$Well, ") with Well (",
            replacements$Well[i], ")\n\n", sep = "")
      }

      m_df <- rows_update(m_df, replacements, by = "Sample description 1")
      assign(m_name, m_df, envir = work_env)
    } else {
      cat("Insufficient Droplets:\n")
      cat("✓ No replacements needed\n\n")
    }

    if (nrow(fully_failed_samples) > 0) {
      failed_ids <- unique(fully_failed_samples$`Sample description 1`)
      samples_failed_droplet_qc <- samples_failed_droplet_qc + length(failed_ids)

      cat("⚠ QC FAILURE: ", length(failed_ids),
          " sample(s) have ALL replicates below ", min_droplets,
          " accepted droplets.\n", sep = "")
      cat("  No replicate is usable as a substitute; the merged-well value\n")
      cat("  for these samples has NOT been corrected and should be treated\n")
      cat("  as unreliable / reviewed manually:\n\n")

      for (sample_name in failed_ids) {
        both_duplicates <- other_df %>% filter(`Sample description 1` == sample_name)
        cat("  Sample:", sample_name, "\n")
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(both_duplicates))) {
          cat("    Well =", both_duplicates$Well[j], ", Accepted Droplets =",
              both_duplicates$`Accepted Droplets`[j], "\n")
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
    }

    # ========================================
    # Check CV for replicate pairs
    # ========================================
    cat("Replicate CV Check:\n")

    cv_data <- other_df %>%
      filter(!SampleType %in% c("PosCtrl", "NTC")) %>%
      group_by(`Sample description 1`) %>%
      filter(n() > 1 & all(`Accepted Droplets` >= min_droplets)) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_conc = mean(`Conc(copies/µL)`, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_conc = sd(`Conc(copies/µL)`, na.rm = TRUE),
        cv = sd_conc / mean_conc,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(cv > cv_threshold)

    if (nrow(cv_data) > 0) {
      cat("⚠ Found", nrow(cv_data), "replicate pair(s) with CV >", cv_threshold, ":\n\n")
      cv_replacements <- tibble()

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(cv_data))) {
        extract <- cv_data$`Sample description 1`[i]
        cv_val <- round(cv_data$cv[i], 4)
        mean_val <- round(cv_data$mean_conc[i], 2)

        cat("Extract ID:", extract, "| CV:", cv_val,
            "| Mean conc:", mean_val, "copies/µL\n")

        both_replicates <- other_df %>%
          filter(`Sample description 1` == extract & !SampleType %in% c("PosCtrl", "NTC"))
        total_positive_droplets <- sum(both_replicates$Positives, na.rm = TRUE)

        # Condition 1: Less than 3 positive droplets collectively
        if (total_positive_droplets < 3) {
          cat("  ℹ No Action Taken: Replicates collectively have less than 3 positive\n")
          cat("    droplets, so high CV is not meaningful.\n\n")
        }
        # Condition 2: One replicate has 0 positive droplets
        else if (any(both_replicates$Positives == 0)) {
          good_rep <- both_replicates %>% filter(Positives > 0)
          cat("  Sample: ", extract, "\n")
          for (j in seq_len(nrow(both_replicates))) {
            cat("    Well =", both_replicates$Well[j], ", Positive Droplets =",
                both_replicates$Positives[j], "\n")
          }
          cat("  → Replacing Merged Well (",
              m_df$Well[m_df$`Sample description 1` == extract],
              ") with Well (", good_rep$Well[1],
              ") because high CV\n    was due to one sample not amplifying.\n\n", sep = "")
          cv_replacements <- bind_rows(cv_replacements, good_rep[1, ])
          samples_replaced_amplification_error <- samples_replaced_amplification_error + 1
          changes_made <- TRUE
        }
        # Condition 3: Neither condition applies
        else {
          cat("  ⚠ ACTION NEEDED: High CV should be further investigated.\n\n")
        }
      }

      if (nrow(cv_replacements) > 0) {
        m_df <- rows_update(m_df, cv_replacements, by = "Sample description 1")
        assign(m_name, m_df, envir = work_env)
      }
    } else {
      cat("✓ All replicate pairs have CV ≤", cv_threshold, "\n\n")
    }

    # ========================================
    # Print final status for this file
    # ========================================
    if (changes_made) {
      cat("✓ Updated", m_name, "\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("✓ No changes needed\n\n")
    }
  }

  # Combine all _M files into one dataframe (excluding controls)
  m_files <- ls(pattern = "_M$", envir = work_env)
  combined_data <- map_df(m_files, function(m_name) {
    get(m_name, envir = work_env)
  }) %>%
    filter(!SampleType %in% c("PosCtrl", "NTC"))

  # Select and rename columns needed for subsequent analyses
  combined_data <- combined_data %>% select(
    well = Well,
    extract_id = `Sample description 1`,
    conc_copies_uL_raw = `Conc(copies/µL)`,
    accepted_droplets = `Accepted Droplets`,
    positive_droplets = Positives,
    negative_droplets = Negatives,
    merged_wells = MergedWells,
    total_conf_max = TotalConfMax,
    total_conf_min = TotalConfMin,
    poisson_conf_max = PoissonConfMax,
    poisson_conf_min = PoissonConfMin,
    total_conf_max_68 = TotalConfidenceMax68,
    total_conf_min_68 = TotalConfidenceMin68,
    poisson_conf_max_68 = PoissonConfidenceMax68,
    poisson_conf_min_68 = PoissonConfidenceMin68
  )

  # ========================================
  # NEW: Parse dilution factor out of extract_id
  # ========================================
  # Some plates (e.g. inhibition testing) name diluted samples as
  # "<id><dilution_sep><numerator>_<denominator>", e.g. "3008 1_5" for a 1:5
  # dilution, while undiluted samples are just "<id>", e.g. "3008". This
  # strips the dilution code off extract_id (so it can still join to the
  # extraction record on the plain numeric ID) and multiplies concentration
  # + all confidence bounds by the dilution factor, before any volume
  # correction happens.
  if (parse_dilution) {
    print_main_section("Parsing Dilution Factors")

    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        extract_id_full = extract_id,
        extract_id = str_trim(str_extract(extract_id_full, paste0("^[^", dilution_sep, "]+"))),
        dilution_code = str_trim(str_remove(extract_id_full, paste0("^[^", dilution_sep, "]+")))
      )

    dil_parts <- str_split_fixed(combined_data$dilution_code, "_", 2)

    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        dilution_factor = ifelse(
          dilution_code == "",
          1,
          as.numeric(dil_parts[, 2]) / as.numeric(dil_parts[, 1])
        )
      ) %>%
      select(-extract_id_full, -dilution_code)

    cat("✓ Parsed dilution codes from extract_id, e.g.:\n")
    cat("    '3008 1_5' -> extract_id = '3008', dilution_factor = 5\n")
    cat("    '3008'     -> extract_id = '3008', dilution_factor = 1\n\n")

    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        conc_copies_uL_raw   = conc_copies_uL_raw   * dilution_factor,
        total_conf_max       = total_conf_max       * dilution_factor,
        total_conf_min       = total_conf_min       * dilution_factor,
        poisson_conf_max     = poisson_conf_max     * dilution_factor,
        poisson_conf_min     = poisson_conf_min     * dilution_factor,
        total_conf_max_68    = total_conf_max_68    * dilution_factor,
        total_conf_min_68    = total_conf_min_68    * dilution_factor,
        poisson_conf_max_68  = poisson_conf_max_68  * dilution_factor,
        poisson_conf_min_68  = poisson_conf_min_68  * dilution_factor
      )

    cat("✓ Applied dilution_factor to concentration and confidence bounds\n\n")
  }

  # Combine with sample identifier information
  extraction_record <- read_csv(extraction_file_location, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(
      sampling_date = Date,
      sampling_start = `Sampling Start`,
      sampling_time = `Time Point`,
      condition = Condition,
      replicate = Replicate,
      sample_id = `Sample Identifier`,
      extract_id = `Extract Storage Number`,
      extraction_date = `Extraction Date`
    ) %>%
    # Coerce to numeric here too, so both sides of the join use the same type.
    # Without this, e.g. character "007" vs numeric 7 silently fails to match.
    mutate(extract_id = as.numeric(extract_id))

  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(extract_id = as.numeric(extract_id)) %>%
    left_join(extraction_record, by = "extract_id")

  # Handle sample exclusions
  if (!is.null(exclude_samples)) {
    print_main_section("Excluding Samples")
    excluded_data <- combined_data %>%
      filter(sample_id %in% exclude_samples)
    samples_excluded <- nrow(excluded_data)

    if (samples_excluded > 0) {
      cat("Excluding", samples_excluded, "non-relevant sample(s):\n\n")
      for (sample in exclude_samples) {
        matching <- excluded_data %>% filter(sample_id == sample)
        if (nrow(matching) > 0) {
          cat("  • ", sample, " (extract_id: ", matching$extract_id[1], ")\n", sep = "")
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
      combined_data <- combined_data %>%
        filter(!sample_id %in% exclude_samples)
    } else {
      cat("No samples matched exclusion criteria\n\n")
    }
  }

  # Handle field blanks and extraction blanks
  if (!is.null(fb_column) || !is.null(eb_column)) {
    print_main_section("FB and EB Controls")

    fb_filter <- if (!is.null(fb_column)) combined_data[[fb_column]] == fb_value else rep(FALSE, nrow(combined_data))
    eb_filter <- if (!is.null(eb_column)) combined_data[[eb_column]] == eb_value else rep(FALSE, nrow(combined_data))

    blanks_data <- combined_data %>% filter(fb_filter | eb_filter)

    if (nrow(blanks_data) > 0) {
      if (!is.null(fb_column)) {
        field_blanks <- sum(blanks_data[[fb_column]] == fb_value, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
      if (!is.null(eb_column)) {
        extraction_blanks <- sum(blanks_data[[eb_column]] == eb_value, na.rm = TRUE)
      }

      display_cols <- c("sample_id", "positive_droplets")
      if (!is.null(fb_column) && fb_column != "sample_id") {
        display_cols <- c(fb_column, display_cols)
      }
      if (!is.null(eb_column) && eb_column != "sample_id" && eb_column != fb_column) {
        display_cols <- c(eb_column, display_cols)
      }

      print(blanks_data %>% select(all_of(unique(display_cols))))
      cat("\n")

      combined_data <- combined_data %>% filter(!(fb_filter | eb_filter))
      cat("✓ Removed", field_blanks, "field blank(s) and", extraction_blanks, "extraction blank(s)\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("No field blanks or extraction blanks found\n\n")
    }
  }

  # ========================================
  # Lambda (Poisson rate) column
  # ========================================
  # lambda = -ln(negative_droplets / accepted_droplets)
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(lambda = -log(negative_droplets / accepted_droplets))

  # ========================================
  # Volume corrections and transformations
  # ========================================
  if (!is.null(V_w)) {
    print_main_section("Applying Volume Corrections")

    cat("PCR reaction volume (V_pcr):        ", V_pcr, "µL\n")
    cat("DNA extraction elution (V_e):       ", V_e, "µL\n")
    cat("Template added to PCR (V_r):        ", V_r, "µL\n")

    if (is.data.frame(V_w)) {
      # NEW: per-sample V_w, for plates that mix samples that came from
      # experiments with different sample volumes (e.g. inhibition testing
      # pulling from both the decay pool [V_w = 1 L] and the shedding pool
      # [V_w = 0.53 L]). V_w must have a "V_w" column and a column matching
      # V_w_join_by (e.g. "extract_id", "sample_id", or "condition").
      if (!all(c(V_w_join_by, "V_w") %in% names(V_w))) {
        stop("V_w lookup table must contain columns '", V_w_join_by, "' and 'V_w'")
      }

      cat("Water sample volume (V_w):            varies by sample (joined on '",
          V_w_join_by, "')\n\n", sep = "")

      combined_data <- combined_data %>%
        left_join(V_w, by = V_w_join_by)

      n_missing_vw <- sum(is.na(combined_data$V_w))
      if (n_missing_vw > 0) {
        warning(n_missing_vw, " sample(s) had no matching V_w in the lookup table; ",
                "their volume-corrected columns will be NA.")
      }

      combined_data <- combined_data %>%
        mutate(
          .correction          = V_pcr * V_e / V_r / V_w,
          copies_per_L         = conc_copies_uL_raw * .correction,
          total_conf_min_L     = coalesce(total_conf_min * .correction, poisson_conf_min * .correction),
          total_conf_max_L     = coalesce(total_conf_max * .correction, poisson_conf_max * .correction),
          total_conf_min_68_L  = coalesce(total_conf_min_68 * .correction, poisson_conf_min_68 * .correction),
          total_conf_max_68_L  = coalesce(total_conf_max_68 * .correction, poisson_conf_max_68 * .correction)
        ) %>%
        select(-.correction)

    } else {
      # Original behavior: a single V_w applied to every sample in the file
      correction <- V_pcr * V_e / V_r / V_w

      cat("Water sample volume (V_w):          ", V_w, "L\n")
      cat("Correction factor:                  ", correction, "\n\n")

      combined_data <- combined_data %>%
        mutate(
          copies_per_L = conc_copies_uL_raw * correction,
          total_conf_min_L = coalesce(total_conf_min * correction, poisson_conf_min * correction),
          total_conf_max_L = coalesce(total_conf_max * correction, poisson_conf_max * correction),
          total_conf_min_68_L = coalesce(total_conf_min_68 * correction, poisson_conf_min_68 * correction),
          total_conf_max_68_L = coalesce(total_conf_max_68 * correction, poisson_conf_max_68 * correction)
        )
    }

    cat("✓ Added columns: copies_per_L, total_conf_min_L, total_conf_max_L\n")

    if (add_log_transform) {
      combined_data <- combined_data %>%
        mutate(
          copies_per_L_log = log10(copies_per_L),
          total_conf_min_L_log = log10(total_conf_min_L),
          total_conf_max_L_log = log10(total_conf_max_L)
        )
      cat("✓ Added log10 transformed columns\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }

  # Add hours_elapsed column if time_prefix is specified
  if (!is.null(time_prefix)) {
    print_main_section("Parsing Time Information")
    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(hours_elapsed = as.numeric(str_remove(sampling_time, time_prefix)))
    cat("✓ Extracted hours_elapsed from sampling_time\n")
    cat("  (Removed prefix: '", time_prefix, "')\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  # Create summary list
  summary_stats <- list(
    total_pos_controls = total_pos_controls,
    total_ntc_controls = total_ntc_controls,
    field_blanks = field_blanks,
    extraction_blanks = extraction_blanks,
    samples_excluded = samples_excluded,
    samples_replaced = samples_replaced,
    samples_replaced_amplification_error = samples_replaced_amplification_error,
    samples_replaced_pipetting_error = samples_replaced_pipetting_error,
    samples_failed_droplet_qc = samples_failed_droplet_qc,
    experimental_samples = total_samples - samples_excluded - field_blanks - extraction_blanks,
    total_samples_processed = total_pos_controls + total_ntc_controls + total_samples
  )

  # Assign final results to global environment (this is the intended output
  # of the function, unlike the temp _M/_other frames which now live in
  # the private work_env and are simply discarded when the function returns)
  assign(output_name, combined_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0(output_name, "_summary"), summary_stats, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  print_main_section("Processing Complete")
  cat("Combined data saved as '", output_name, "'\n", sep = "")
  cat("Summary statistics saved as '", output_name, "_summary'\n", sep = "")
  cat("Temporary per-file data frames were kept in a private environment\n")
  cat("and were not written to your workspace.\n\n")

  # Print final summary
  print_main_section("PROCESSING SUMMARY")
  cat("Total samples processed:\n")
  cat("  • Positive controls (PosCtrl):        ", total_pos_controls, "\n")
  cat("  • Negative controls (NTC):            ", total_ntc_controls, "\n")
  cat("  • Field blanks (FB):                  ", field_blanks, "\n")
  cat("  • Extraction blanks (EB):             ", extraction_blanks, "\n")
  cat("  • Excluded samples (not relevant):    ", samples_excluded, "\n")
  cat("  • Experimental samples:               ", summary_stats$experimental_samples, "\n")
  cat("  • TOTAL:                              ", summary_stats$total_samples_processed, "\n\n")

  cat("Quality control actions:\n")
  cat("  • Samples with insufficient droplets: ", samples_replaced, "\n")
  cat("    (Replaced with single replicate\n")
  cat("     having ≥", min_droplets, " droplets)\n", sep = "")
  cat("  • Amplification errors detected:      ", samples_replaced_amplification_error, "\n")
  cat("    (Replaced with single replicate\n")
  cat("     because other did not amplify)\n")
  cat("  • Manually flagged pipetting errors:  ", samples_replaced_pipetting_error, "\n")
  cat("    (Replaced with surviving replicate\n")
  cat("     after excluding the flagged well)\n")
  cat("  • Samples failing droplet QC entirely: ", samples_failed_droplet_qc, "\n")
  cat("    (ALL replicates below ", min_droplets,
      " droplets; left uncorrected, needs manual review)\n\n", sep = "")

  invisible(summary_stats)
}

# Reading and QCing shedding, decay, and inhibition files

report_partitions <- function(df, label) {
  ad <- df$accepted_droplets
  lam <- df$lambda

  stats <- list(
    accepted_droplets = list(
      mean = mean(ad, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(ad, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(ad, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(ad, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    lambda = list(
      mean = mean(lam, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(lam, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(lam, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(lam, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  cat(sprintf(
    "%s - accepted_droplets: mean = %.2f, SD = %.2f, range = [%.0f, %.0f]\n",
    label,
    stats$accepted_droplets$mean, stats$accepted_droplets$sd,
    stats$accepted_droplets$min, stats$accepted_droplets$max
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "%s - lambda: mean = %.4f, SD = %.4f, range = [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
    label,
    stats$lambda$mean, stats$lambda$sd,
    stats$lambda$min, stats$lambda$max
  ))

  invisible(stats)
}
```

```{r, ddPCR File Reading & QC }
      mean = mean(ad, na.rm = TRUE),

#Inhibition

# This plate mixes samples originally drawn from the decay pool (V_w = 1 L)
# and the shedding pool (V_w = 0.53 L), and some samples are run at 1:5 or
# 1:10 dilutions (encoded in "Sample description 1" as e.g. "3008 1_5",
# with undiluted samples as just "3008").
#
# Build a per-sample V_w lookup keyed on extract_id. Decay vs. shedding is
# told apart by the "Time Point" prefix in the extraction record: "D-..."
# means the sample came from the decay experiment (V_w = 1 L), "S-..."
# means it came from the shedding experiment (V_w = 0.53 L).
inhibition_vw_lookup <- read_csv("Data/Extraction_Record.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    extract_id = as.numeric(`Extract Storage Number`),
    V_w = case_when(
      str_starts(`Time Point`, "D-") ~ 1,
      str_starts(`Time Point`, "S-") ~ 0.53
    )
  )

read_ddpcr_files(
  "Data/ddPCR Files/Inhibition",
  "Data/Extraction_Record.csv",
  "inhibition_data",
  exclude_wells = c("C02", "F04"),
  parse_dilution = TRUE,
  fb_column = "condition",
  eb_column = "sample_id",
  V_pcr = 20,
  V_e = 100,
  V_r = 5,
  V_w = inhibition_vw_lookup,
  V_w_join_by = "extract_id",
  min_droplets = 10000
)
```

```{r Decay Analysis}
# ============================================================
# Decay Analysis
# ============================================================
# Calculating decay rate constants

#Calculate Decay LOD
decay_LOD = droplet_LOD(3, mean(decay_data$accepted_droplets), 20, 100, 5, 1)

# Calculate C0
decay_data <- decay_data %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    C0 = mean(copies_per_L[hours_elapsed == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    C0_stdev = sd(copies_per_L[hours_elapsed == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate ln(C/C0) and associated error
decay_data <- decay_data %>%
  mutate(
    C_C0 = copies_per_L / C0,
    ln_C_C0 = log(C_C0),
    approx_C_stdev = pmax(total_conf_max_68_L - copies_per_L, copies_per_L - total_conf_min_68_L),
    C_C0_stdev = C_C0*sqrt(((approx_C_stdev/copies_per_L)^2+(C0_stdev/C0)^2)),
    ln_C_C0_lower_error = log(C_C0 - C_C0_stdev),
    ln_C_C0_upper_error = log(C_C0 + C_C0_stdev)
    
  ) 

# Fit models through origin
fit_light <- lm(ln_C_C0 ~ 0 + hours_elapsed, data = subset(decay_data, condition == "Light"))
fit_dark <- lm(ln_C_C0 ~ 0 + hours_elapsed, data = subset(decay_data, condition == "Dark"))
fit_all <- lm(ln_C_C0 ~ 0 + hours_elapsed, data = decay_data)

# View model summaries
summary(fit_light)
summary(fit_dark)
summary(fit_all)

# >>>> EXTRACT MODEL STATS FUNCTION <<<<
#Saves the needed model stats in a data frame
extract_model_stats <- function(model, condition_name) {
  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients["hours_elapsed", ]
  data.frame(
    Condition = condition_name,
    k = -coef_summary["Estimate"],
    SE = coef_summary["Std. Error"],
    Adj_R2 = summary(model)$adj.r.squared,
    Half_life = log(2) / -coef_summary["Estimate"]
  )
}

#Group model results in summary data frame
model_results_summary <- bind_rows(
  extract_model_stats(fit_light, "Light"),
  extract_model_stats(fit_dark, "Dark"),
  extract_model_stats(fit_all, "All Combined")
)

#Calculate z-score
z_score <- with(
  model_results_summary,
  (k[Condition == "Light"] - k[Condition == "Dark"]) /
    sqrt(SE[Condition == "Light"]^2 + SE[Condition == "Dark"]^2)
)
p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_score))
```

```{r Shedding Analysis}
  select(

# Read the star stress spreadsheet
star_stress <- read_excel("Data/Star Stress Summary.xlsx")

# Find columns matching the X_XX_X pattern (health check columns)
health_check_cols <- grep("^[0-9]+_[0-9]+_[0-9]+$", names(star_stress), value = TRUE)

# Create the binary TRUE/FALSE column for any stress indicator
star_stress <- star_stress %>%
  mutate(
    Stress_Response = (`Addition Stress` == 1) |
      (`Removal Stress` == 1) |
      (rowSums(across(all_of(health_check_cols)) >= 2) > 0),
    # Numerical stress score (sum of all stress columns minus baseline
    # of number of health check columns)
    Stress_Score = rowSums(across(all_of(c("Addition Stress", "Removal Stress", health_check_cols)))) -
      length(health_check_cols)
  ) %>%
  rename(condition = `Star ID`)

shedding_data <- shedding_data %>% left_join(star_stress, by = "condition")
rm(star_stress)

# Set up time points to plot
shedding_data <- shedding_data %>%
  mutate(time_ordered = match(hours_elapsed, sort(unique(hours_elapsed))) - 1)


# Identify the final three timepoints
final_three_times <- shedding_data %>%
  distinct(hours_elapsed) %>%
  arrange(desc(hours_elapsed)) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  pull(hours_elapsed)

# Add a column to identify final three timepoints
shedding_data <- shedding_data %>%
  mutate(is_final_three = hours_elapsed %in% final_three_times)

# Function to convert date and time code to hours_elapsed
convert_to_hours <- function(date_str, time_code) {
  # Parse the date from column name (e.g., "9_16" from "9_16_1")
  month_day <- str_extract(date_str, "\\d+_\\d+")
  month <- as.numeric(str_split(month_day, "_")[[1]][1])
  day <- as.numeric(str_split(month_day, "_")[[1]][2])
  
  # Calculate days from start (9/15)
  days_elapsed <- day - 15
  
  # Convert time code to hours within day
  hours_within_day <- case_when(
    time_code == 1 ~ 9,   # 9am
    time_code == 2 ~ 12,  # 12pm
    time_code == 3 ~ 16   # 4pm
  )
  
  # Calculate total hours from start (4pm on 9/15)
  total_hours <- days_elapsed * 24 + (hours_within_day - 16)
  
  return(total_hours)
}
```

```{r Shedding Rates}
#NEED TO FORMAT

#Calculate steady state

k  <- model_results_summary %>% filter(Condition == "All Combined") %>% pull(k)
SE <- model_results_summary %>% filter(Condition == "All Combined") %>% pull(SE)

# Filter for the specific time points
steady_state_subset <- shedding_data[shedding_data$hours_elapsed %in% c(66, 69, 72), ]

# Calculate shedding rates for each individual time point
individual_rates <- steady_state_subset %>%
  mutate(
    shedding_rate = copies_per_L * volume * k,
    shedding_rate_g = shedding_rate / star_weight_g,
    size_rank = factor(size_rank)
  )

# Calculate the average-based shedding rate (your original approach)
average_rates <- steady_state_subset %>%
  group_by(star_name, size_rank, star_UPD_size_mm, star_weight_g, 
           volume, Stress_Response, Stress_Score) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_copies_per_L = mean(copies_per_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_copies_per_L = sd(copies_per_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_error = sqrt((SE/k)^2 + (sd_copies_per_L/avg_copies_per_L)^2),
    shedding_rate = avg_copies_per_L * volume * k,
    shedding_rate_SD = rel_error * shedding_rate,
    shedding_rate_g = shedding_rate / star_weight_g,
    shedding_rate_g_SD = rel_error * shedding_rate_g,
    size_rank = factor(size_rank)
  )

# Summary statistics for shedding rates
shedding_summary <- average_rates %>%
  summarise(
    # Shedding rate (per individual)
    shedding_rate_min = min(shedding_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_max = max(shedding_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_mean = mean(shedding_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_sd = sd(shedding_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Shedding rate per gram
    shedding_rate_g_min = min(shedding_rate_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_g_max = max(shedding_rate_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_g_mean = mean(shedding_rate_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    shedding_rate_g_sd = sd(shedding_rate_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# View the summary
print(shedding_summary)

# Random-intercept model: allows each individual to have its own baseline shedding rate
mixed_model_individual <- lmer(shedding_rate ~ 1 + (1 | star_name), data = individual_rates)

# ICC: proportion of total variance attributable to between-individual differences
icc(mixed_model_individual)

# Formal test of whether the individual random effect is significantly > 0
# (likelihood ratio test comparing with vs. without the random intercept)
library(lmerTest)  # or use ranova() from lmerTest for a formal p-value
ranova(mixed_model_individual)

# Random-intercept model: allows each individual to have its own baseline shedding rate
mixed_model_biomass <- lmer(shedding_rate_g ~ 1 + (1 | star_name), data = individual_rates)

# ICC: proportion of total variance attributable to between-individual differences
icc(mixed_model_biomass)

# Formal test of whether the individual random effect is significantly > 0
# (likelihood ratio test comparing with vs. without the random intercept)
library(lmerTest)  # or use ranova() from lmerTest for a formal p-value
ranova(mixed_model_biomass)






# =========================================================================
# 2. BUILD MODEL DATA - biomass, UPD size, stress score, log outcomes
# =========================================================================
 
model_data <- average_rates %>%
  mutate(
    biomass = star_weight_g,
    log_shedding_rate   = log(shedding_rate),      # requires shedding_rate > 0
    log_shedding_rate_g = log(shedding_rate_g)      # requires shedding_rate_g > 0
  )
 
# =========================================================================
# 3. MULTIPLE REGRESSION: log(shedding_rate) and log(shedding_rate_g)
#    predicted by biomass + UPD size + stress score
# =========================================================================
 
# Check predictor-predictor collinearity first
predictor_cor_matrix <- cor(
  model_data[, c("biomass", "star_UPD_size_mm", "Stress_Score")],
  use = "complete.obs"
)
cat("\n--- Predictor-predictor correlation matrix ---\n")
print(round(predictor_cor_matrix, 2))
 
final_model_raw <- lm(log_shedding_rate ~ biomass + star_UPD_size_mm + Stress_Score,
                       data = model_data)
final_model_norm <- lm(log_shedding_rate_g ~ biomass + star_UPD_size_mm + Stress_Score,
                        data = model_data)
 
cat("\n--- Multiple regression: log(shedding_rate) ---\n")
print(summary(final_model_raw))
cat("VIF:\n")
print(vif(final_model_raw))
 
cat("\n--- Multiple regression: log(shedding_rate_g) ---\n")
print(summary(final_model_norm))
cat("VIF:\n")
print(vif(final_model_norm))
```

```{r Literature Review, cache=TRUE, cache.extra = tools::md5sum(c("Decay_Rates_Summary.xlsx", "Shedding_Rates_Summary.xlsx"))}
#NEED TO FORMAT



# Function to get taxonomic information from GBIF with special cases
get_taxonomy <- function(scientific_name) {
  # Handle specific problematic genera
  search_name <- scientific_name
  
  if (scientific_name == "Palaeomenes") {
    search_name <- "Palaemonetes"
  }
  
  # Use a lookup for phylum-specific searches
  phylum_lookup <- list(
    "Diplosoma" = "Chordata",
    "Chrysaora" = "Cnidaria"
  )
  
  if (search_name %in% names(phylum_lookup)) {
    result <- name_backbone(name = search_name, phylum = phylum_lookup[[search_name]], verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    result <- name_backbone(name = search_name, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Helper function to safely extract fields
  safe_extract <- function(field) {
    ifelse(is.null(result[[field]]) || length(result[[field]]) == 0, NA, result[[field]])
  }
  
  # Return a data frame with taxonomic info
  data.frame(
    scientific_name = scientific_name,
    kingdom = safe_extract("kingdom"),
    phylum = safe_extract("phylum"),
    class = safe_extract("class"),
    order = safe_extract("order"),
    family = safe_extract("family"),
    genus = safe_extract("genus"),
    rank = safe_extract("rank"),
    matchType = safe_extract("matchType"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Function to process dataset (works for both decay and shedding data)
process_dataset <- function(filepath, dataset_name) {
  cat("\n==== Processing", dataset_name, "====\n")
  
  read_excel(filepath) %>%
    mutate(
      cleaned_scientific_name = trimws(gsub("spp\\.", "", `Organism Scientific Name`)),
      Temperature = as.numeric(Temperature),
      Study_Type = ifelse(Reference == "This study", "This study", "Literature")
    ) %>%
    # Convert Fragment length to numeric if it exists
    {if ("Fragment length (bp)" %in% names(.)) 
      mutate(., `Fragment length (bp)` = as.numeric(`Fragment length (bp)`)) 
      else .}
}

# Simplified taxonomy retrieval with progress messages
get_all_taxonomy <- function(species_vector, dataset_name = "data") {
  cat("\n==== Querying GBIF for", length(species_vector), "taxa from", dataset_name, "====\n")
  
  taxonomy_df <- lapply(seq_along(species_vector), function(i) {
    cat("Processing", i, "of", length(species_vector), ":", species_vector[i], "\n")
    get_taxonomy(species_vector[i])
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  cat("\nTaxonomic matches:\n")
  print(taxonomy_df %>% select(scientific_name, rank, matchType, phylum, class))
  
  return(taxonomy_df)
}

# ==== LOAD AND PROCESS BOTH DATASETS ====

decay_data_literature <- process_dataset("Decay_Rates_Summary.xlsx", "Decay Data")
shedding_data_literature <- process_dataset("Shedding_Rates_Summary.xlsx", "Shedding Data")

# ==== GET TAXONOMY FOR BOTH DATASETS ====

all_unique_species <- unique(c(
  decay_data_literature$cleaned_scientific_name,
  shedding_data_literature$cleaned_scientific_name
))

taxonomy_df_all <- get_all_taxonomy(all_unique_species, "all datasets")

# Merge taxonomy with both datasets
decay_data_literature <- decay_data_literature %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_df_all, by = c("cleaned_scientific_name" = "scientific_name"))

shedding_data_literature <- shedding_data_literature %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_df_all, by = c("cleaned_scientific_name" = "scientific_name"))

# ==== CREATE UNIFIED PHYLUM LEVELS ====

all_phyla <- sort(unique(c(
  decay_data_literature$phylum[!is.na(decay_data_literature$phylum)],
  shedding_data_literature$phylum[!is.na(shedding_data_literature$phylum)]
)))

cat("\nAll phyla across datasets:", paste(all_phyla, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Function to set phylum factor levels
set_phylum_levels <- function(data, levels) {
  mutate(data, phylum = factor(phylum, levels = levels))
}

decay_data_literature <- set_phylum_levels(decay_data_literature, all_phyla)
shedding_data_literature <- set_phylum_levels(shedding_data_literature, all_phyla)

# ==== CALCULATE GLOBAL TEMPERATURE RANGE ====

temp_range <- range(c(decay_data_literature$Temperature, 
                      shedding_data_literature$Temperature), 
                    na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nGlobal temperature range:", temp_range[1], "to", temp_range[2], "°C\n")

# ==== PREPARE SHEDDING DATA SUBSETS ====

shedding_data_clean <- shedding_data_literature %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Standardized Shedding Rate`), 
         !is.na(`Standardized Shedding Rate Units`),
         !is.na(`Organism Common Name`))

data_per_individual <- shedding_data_clean %>%
  filter(`Standardized Shedding Rate Units` == "copies/hr/individual") %>%
  set_phylum_levels(all_phyla)

data_per_gram <- shedding_data_clean %>%
  filter(`Standardized Shedding Rate Units` == "copies/hr/g") %>%
  set_phylum_levels(all_phyla)


# ==== SUMMARY STATISTICS ====


cat("\n==== SUMMARY STATISTICS (Literature only) ====\n\n")

# Filter for literature data only
decay_lit <- decay_data_literature %>% filter(Study_Type == "Literature")
shedding_gram_lit <- data_per_gram %>% filter(Study_Type == "Literature")
shedding_ind_lit <- data_per_individual %>% filter(Study_Type == "Literature")

# Function to calculate and print summary stats
print_summary <- function(data, value_col, metric_name, filter_desc = "All literature") {
  values <- data[[value_col]][!is.na(data[[value_col]])]
  
  if (length(values) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%s - %s:\n", filter_desc, metric_name))
    cat(sprintf("  N = %d\n", length(values)))
    cat(sprintf("  Range: %f to %f (%.2e to %.2e)\n", 
                min(values), max(values), min(values), max(values)))
    cat(sprintf("  Average: %f (%.2e)\n\n", mean(values), mean(values)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("%s - %s: No data\n\n", filter_desc, metric_name))
  }
}

# 1. Overall decay rate statistics
print_summary(decay_lit, "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)", "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)")

# 2. Overall shedding rate (copies/hr/g)
print_summary(shedding_gram_lit, "Standardized Shedding Rate", "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/g)")

# 3. Overall shedding rate (copies/hr/individual)
print_summary(shedding_ind_lit, "Standardized Shedding Rate", "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/individual)")

# 4. Echinodermata - decay rate
decay_echino <- decay_lit %>% filter(phylum == "Echinodermata")
print_summary(decay_echino, "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)", 
              "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)", "Echinodermata")

# 5. Echinodermata - shedding rate (copies/hr/g)
shedding_gram_echino <- shedding_gram_lit %>% filter(phylum == "Echinodermata")
print_summary(shedding_gram_echino, "Standardized Shedding Rate", 
              "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/g)", "Echinodermata")

# 6. Echinodermata - shedding rate (copies/hr/individual)
shedding_ind_echino <- shedding_ind_lit %>% filter(phylum == "Echinodermata")
print_summary(shedding_ind_echino, "Standardized Shedding Rate", 
              "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/individual)", "Echinodermata")

# 7. Temperature-matched decay rates and shedding rates 

temp_matched_summary <- function(lit_data, this_study_data, value_col, metric_name) {
  this_study_temps <- this_study_data %>% filter(Study_Type == "This study") %>%
    pull(Temperature) %>% na.omit()

  if (length(this_study_temps) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Temperature-matched %s: No 'This study' temperatures available\n\n", metric_name))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  matched <- lit_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Temperature)) %>%
    filter(sapply(Temperature, function(t) any(abs(t - this_study_temps) <= 5)))

  cat(sprintf("Temperature-matched (±5°C from This study temps: %s) - %s:\n",
              paste(round(this_study_temps, 1), collapse = ", "), metric_name))
  print_summary(matched, value_col, metric_name, "Temp-matched")
}

temp_matched_summary(decay_lit, decay_data_literature, "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)", "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)")
temp_matched_summary(shedding_gram_lit, data_per_gram, "Standardized Shedding Rate", "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/g)")
temp_matched_summary(shedding_ind_lit, data_per_individual, "Standardized Shedding Rate", "Shedding Rate (copies/hr/individual)")

cat("==== END OF SUMMARY STATISTICS ====\n\n")
```

```{r Figure 6}
# ==== DEFINE SHARED AESTHETIC ELEMENTS ====

set.seed(28)

# Shared geom parameters
shared_boxplot_params <- list(
  fill = "gray80",
  alpha = 0.7,
  outlier.shape = NA
)

shared_jitter_params <- list(
  width = 0.2,
  size = 3.5,
  alpha = 0.8,
  shape = 21
)

literature_stroke <- 0.3
this_study_stroke <- 2

# Shared scale parameters
shared_fill_scale <- scale_fill_viridis_c(
  option = "magma",
  name = "Temperature (°C)",
  limits = temp_range,
  na.value = "gray50",
  guide = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title.position = "top",
    barwidth = 10,
    barheight = 1
  )
)

shared_color_scale <- scale_color_manual(
  values = c("This study" = "yellow", "Literature" = "black"),
  name = "Source",
  guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      fill = "gray50",
      stroke = c(literature_stroke, this_study_stroke),
      size = 4
    ),
    direction = "horizontal",
    title.position = "top"
  )
)

shared_x_scale <- scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

# ==== HELPER FUNCTIONS ====

# Function to create jitter layers for both study types
add_jitter_layer <- function(data, show_legend = TRUE) {
  data <- data %>% mutate(point_stroke = ifelse(Study_Type == "This study", this_study_stroke, literature_stroke))
  do.call(geom_jitter, c(
    list(
      data = data,
      mapping = aes(fill = Temperature, color = Study_Type, stroke = point_stroke),
      show.legend = show_legend
    ),
    shared_jitter_params
  ))
}

# Function to create base plot structure
create_base_plot <- function(data, y_var, y_label, hide_x_axis = TRUE, log_scale = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = phylum, y = .data[[y_var]])) +
    do.call(geom_boxplot, shared_boxplot_params) +
    shared_x_scale +
    shared_fill_scale +
    shared_color_scale +
    theme_paper() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    ) +
    labs(y = y_label)
  
  # Add log scale if needed
  if (log_scale) {
    p <- p + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log())
  }
  
  # Hide x-axis if needed
  if (hide_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(x = "Phylum")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ==== CREATE THE THREE PLOTS ====

# Plot 1: Decay rates
plot_decay <- create_base_plot(
  data = decay_data_literature,
  y_var = "Decay Rate Constant (/hr)",
```

```{r, Supplemental Material - UVA/UVB}
# ============================================================================
# SETUP
# ============================================================================

WAVELENGTH_RANGES <- list(
  UVB = c(280, 315),
  UVA = c(316, 400),
  UV_COMBINED = c(280, 400)
)

in_range <- function(wavelength, range) {
  wavelength >= range[1] & wavelength <= range[2]
}

filter_wavelength <- function(data, range) {
  data %>%
    filter(wavelength_nm >= range[1] & wavelength_nm <= range[2])
}

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 1: DAILY AVERAGE UVA AND UVB IRRADIANCE (MEASURED AT SURFACE)
# Irradiance from 280-315 nm is summed to get UVB and 316-400 nm to get UVA.
# Night-time hours (no measurements) are filled with irradiance = 0 before
# averaging, then daily averages are taken across all points for that day.
# -> Figure S1
# ============================================================================

## 1a. Read field radiometer data --------------------------------------------
radiometer_data <- dir_ls("Data/Radiometer", regexp = "\\.csv$") %>%
  map_df(function(file) {
    filename <- path_file(file) %>% str_remove("\\.csv$")
    parts <- str_split(filename, "_")[[1]]
    read_tsv(file, skip = 10,
             col_names = c("wavelength_nm", "irradiance_W_m2"),
             col_types = "dd") %>%
      mutate(
        irradiance_W_m2 = irradiance_W_m2 / 100,  # Convert from uW/cm2 to W/m2
        date = parts[1],
        time = parts[2],
        condition = parts[3],
        filename = filename,
        .before = wavelength_nm
      )
  })

## 1b. Fill each day's time series with zero-irradiance points for the
##     unsampled night-time hours, before and after the day's measurements --
complete_time_series <- function(summary_data, uv_type) {
  irradiance_col <- names(summary_data)[grep("irradiance", names(summary_data))][1]

  all_conditions <- summary_data %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition)

  complete_list <- map_df(all_conditions, function(cond) {
    summary_cond <- summary_data %>%
      filter(condition == cond)

    complete_df <- summary_cond %>%
      group_by(date) %>%
      mutate(
        time_diffs = c(NA, as.numeric(difftime(time[-1], time[-n()], units = "mins"))),
        sampling_freq_mins = median(time_diffs, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_time = min(time),
        max_time = max(time),
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!is.na(sampling_freq_mins)) %>%
      nest(data = -date) %>%
      mutate(
        complete_data = map2(data, date, function(df, date_val) {
          sampling_freq <- df$sampling_freq_mins[1]
          min_t_secs <- as.numeric(df$min_time[1], units = "secs")
          max_t_secs <- as.numeric(df$max_time[1], units = "secs")
          sampling_freq_secs <- sampling_freq * 60
          day_start_secs <- 0
          day_end_secs <- 86399

          # Times BEFORE the first measurement
          times_before_secs <- if (min_t_secs - sampling_freq_secs > day_start_secs) {
            seq(day_start_secs, min_t_secs - sampling_freq_secs, by = sampling_freq_secs)
          } else {
            numeric(0)
          }
          times_before <- hms::as_hms(times_before_secs)

          # Times AFTER the last measurement
          times_after_secs <- if (max_t_secs + sampling_freq_secs <= day_end_secs) {
            seq(max_t_secs + sampling_freq_secs, day_end_secs, by = sampling_freq_secs)
          } else {
            numeric(0)
          }
          times_after <- hms::as_hms(times_after_secs)

          # Combine: before times (zeros) + original measurements + after times (zeros)
          bind_rows(
            tibble(time = times_before,
                   !!sym(irradiance_col) := 0,
                   data_type = "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance"),
            df %>% select(time, all_of(irradiance_col)) %>%
              mutate(data_type = "Original measurement"),
            tibble(time = times_after,
                   !!sym(irradiance_col) := 0,
                   data_type = "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance")
          ) %>%
            arrange(time)
        })
      ) %>%
      unnest(complete_data) %>%
      select(date, time, all_of(irradiance_col), data_type) %>%
      mutate(condition = cond)

    complete_df
  })

  complete_list
}

## 1c. Sum irradiance within a wavelength range, optionally apply per-
##     wavelength attenuation and/or absorption adjustments (used again in
##     Sections 2 and 3 once those adjustment tables exist), complete each
##     day's time series (1b), and compute daily averages -------------------
process_uv <- function(radiometer_data, wavelength_range, uv_type,
                        attenuation_table = NULL, absorption_table = NULL,
                        apply_attenuation = FALSE, apply_absorption = FALSE) {

  filtered_data <- radiometer_data %>%
    filter_wavelength(wavelength_range)

  # STEP 1: attenuation adjustment (pouch vs. sunlight, per wavelength)
  if (apply_attenuation && !is.null(attenuation_table)) {
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      left_join(
        attenuation_table %>% select(wavelength_nm, attenuation_factor),
        by = "wavelength_nm"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        attenuation_factor = replace_na(attenuation_factor, 1),
        irradiance_W_m2 = irradiance_W_m2 * attenuation_factor
      )

    n_unmatched <- sum(is.na(filtered_data$attenuation_factor))
    if (n_unmatched > 0) {
      print(paste(uv_type, "- warning:", n_unmatched,
                   "rows had no matching wavelength in the attenuation adjustment table (factor = 1 applied)"))
    }
  }

  # STEP 2: absorption / light-screening adjustment, applied on top of
  # whatever irradiance_W_m2 currently holds (i.e. sequentially after the
  # attenuation adjustment above, if that was also applied)
  if (apply_absorption && !is.null(absorption_table)) {
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      left_join(
        absorption_table %>% select(wavelength_nm, light_screening_factor),
        by = "wavelength_nm"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        light_screening_factor = replace_na(light_screening_factor, 1),
        irradiance_W_m2 = irradiance_W_m2 * light_screening_factor
      )

    n_unmatched <- sum(is.na(filtered_data$light_screening_factor))
    if (n_unmatched > 0) {
      print(paste(uv_type, "- warning:", n_unmatched,
                   "rows had no matching wavelength in the absorption adjustment table (factor = 1 applied)"))
    }
  }

  # Summary built from the already-adjusted, per-wavelength data
  summary_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(date, time, condition) %>%
    summarise(irradiance_sum = sum(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(time = parse_time(time, format = "%H%M")) %>%
    arrange(date, time, condition) %>%
    rename(!!sym(paste0(tolower(uv_type), "_irradiance_sum")) := irradiance_sum)

  irradiance_col <- names(summary_data)[grep("irradiance", names(summary_data))]

  complete_data_adjusted <- complete_time_series(summary_data, uv_type)

  daily_average <- complete_data_adjusted %>%
    group_by(date, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_irradiance = mean(!!sym(irradiance_col)),
      n_measurements = sum(data_type == "Original measurement"),
      n_filled_zeros = sum(data_type == "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(!!sym(paste0("mean_", tolower(uv_type), "_irradiance")) := mean_irradiance) %>%
    arrange(date, condition)

  adjustment_label <- if (apply_attenuation && apply_absorption) {
    " (Attenuation + Absorption Adjusted)"
  } else if (apply_attenuation) {
    " (Attenuation Adjusted)"
  } else if (apply_absorption) {
    " (Absorption Adjusted)"
  } else {
    ""
  }
  print(paste(uv_type, "Daily averages", adjustment_label, ":"))
  print(daily_average)

  mean_col <- names(daily_average)[grep("^mean_", names(daily_average))][1]
  light_means <- daily_average %>% filter(condition == "Light") %>% pull(!!sym(mean_col))
  dark_means  <- daily_average %>% filter(condition == "Dark")  %>% pull(!!sym(mean_col))

  if (length(light_means) > 0) {
    print(paste(uv_type, "Light - Overall mean of daily averages:", round(mean(light_means, na.rm = TRUE), 2)))
  }
  if (length(dark_means) > 0) {
    print(paste(uv_type, "Dark - Overall mean of daily averages:", round(mean(dark_means, na.rm = TRUE), 2)))
  }
  print("---")

  list(
    summary = summary_data,
    complete = complete_data_adjusted,
    daily_average = daily_average
  )
}

## 1d. Unadjusted ("Measured at Surface") daily averages for UVB and UVA ----
uvb_results <- process_uv(radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVB, "UVB")
uva_results <- process_uv(radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVA, "UVA")

## 1e. Figure S1: UVA (A) / UVB (B) irradiance across the day, with
##     night-time zero-irradiance points shown as open circles --------------
condition_colors <- c("Light" = "#CCBB44", "Dark" = "#4477AA")

parse_paper_date <- function(x) {
  # e.g. "15Sept2025" -> Date (day + non-standard 4-letter month + year)
  as.Date(sub("Sept", "Sep", x), format = "%d%b%Y")
}

add_datetime <- function(df) {
  # Collapse date + time-of-day into one continuous POSIXct, sorted
  # chronologically so lines connect points in the right order
  df %>%
    mutate(
      date = parse_paper_date(date),
      time_of_day = format(as.POSIXct(time), "%H:%M:%S"),
      datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time_of_day),
                             format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                             tz = "UTC")
    ) %>%
    select(-time_of_day) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

draw_light_on_top <- function(df) {
  # ggplot draws points in row order; put Dark first, Light last so Light
  # sits on top whenever the two overlap
  df %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Dark", "Light"))) %>%
    arrange(condition)
}

# tick_interval  - spacing of the time-of-day ticks, e.g. "2 hours"
# panel_letter   - passed to panel_label(), e.g. "A"
# show_date_axis - draws the day-separator/date sub-axis beneath the x-axis
#                  (only needed once, on the bottom-most panel)
make_irradiance_plot <- function(data, y_var, y_label,
                                  tick_interval = "3 hours",
                                  panel_letter = NULL,
                                  show_date_axis = TRUE) {

  y_max <- max(data[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- 0
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  original_pts <- data %>% filter(data_type == "Original measurement") %>% draw_light_on_top()
  extended_pts <- data %>% filter(data_type == "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance") %>% draw_light_on_top()

  # Anchor tick breaks to midnight of the first day, not to whatever time
  # the data happens to start at
  axis_start <- as.POSIXct(format(min(data$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d"), tz = "UTC")
  axis_end   <- as.POSIXct(format(max(data$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d"), tz = "UTC") + 86400
  time_breaks <- seq(axis_start, axis_end, by = tick_interval)

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = datetime, y = .data[[y_var]], color = condition)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = condition), alpha = 1) +
    geom_point(
      data = original_pts,
      aes(shape = "Original measurement",
          fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, 0.5))),
      size = 2, stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = extended_pts,
      aes(shape = "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance"),
      fill = NA, alpha = 1, size = 2, stroke = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Original measurement" = 21,
                 "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance" = 1),
      labels = c("Original measurement" = "Original measurement",
                 "Time Series Extended with 0 Irradiance" = "Time Series Extended\n(Irradiance = 0)"),
      name = "Data Type"
    ) +
    scale_x_datetime(breaks = time_breaks, labels = format(time_breaks, "%H:%M")) +
    # No `limits` here: scale limits silently drop data (and the below-axis
    # annotations added further down); the 0..y_max view is enforced via
    # coord_cartesian() instead.
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_paper()

  if (!is.null(panel_letter)) {
    p <- p + panel_label(panel_letter)
  }

  p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max), clip = "on")

  if (show_date_axis) {
    dates_present <- sort(unique(data$date))
    n_days <- length(dates_present)
    day_starts <- as.POSIXct(dates_present, tz = "UTC")
    day_ends   <- as.POSIXct(dates_present + 1, tz = "UTC")
    day_starts[1]    <- min(data$datetime)
    day_ends[n_days] <- axis_end

    day_spans <- tibble(
      date = dates_present,
      x_min = day_starts,
      x_max = day_ends
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        x_center = x_min + (x_max - x_min) / 2,
        day_label = paste0("Day ", row_number()),
        date_label = format(date, "%d %B %Y")
      )

    # Fractions of this panel's y-range, scaled for h ~= 120mm (see
    # save_pdf_png call below); rescale if that height changes.
    tick_top_y     <- y_min - y_range * 0.30
    bracket_line_y <- y_min - y_range * 0.40
    day_label_y    <- y_min - y_range * 0.47   # "Day N", bold
    date_label_y   <- y_min - y_range * 0.58   # date, plain
    time_label_y   <- y_min - y_range * 0.82   # "Local Time (GMT-7)"

    end_ticks <- tibble(x = c(day_spans$x_min, day_spans$x_max))

    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = day_spans,
        aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, y = bracket_line_y, yend = bracket_line_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_segment(
        data = end_ticks,
        aes(x = x, xend = x, y = bracket_line_y, yend = tick_top_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = day_spans,
        aes(x = x_center, y = day_label_y, label = day_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1,
        size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = day_spans,
        aes(x = x_center, y = date_label_y, label = date_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1,
        size = 3.0, fontface = "plain", color = "black"
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = mean(range(data$datetime)), y = time_label_y,
        label = "Local Time (GMT-7)",
        hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = theme_font_sizes$axis_labels / 2.8
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max), clip = "off") +
      theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 40, l = 5.5))
  }

  p
}

uvb_complete <- add_datetime(uvb_results$complete)
uva_complete <- add_datetime(uva_results$complete)

uva_panel <- make_irradiance_plot(
  data = uva_complete,

  tick_interval = "6 hours",

) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # theme_paper() may fix a height:width ratio for standalone figures;
    # override it here so this panel can freely fill the combined figure
    aspect.ratio = NULL
  )

uvb_panel <- make_irradiance_plot(

  tick_interval = "6 hours",

) +

Figure_S1 <- (uva_panel / uvb_panel / guide_area()) +

  ) &

    legend.key.size = unit(0.7, "lines"),

    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) &

    shape = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1, keyheight = unit(1.8, "lines"))

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 2: ATTENUATION OF UVA/UVB BY THE POUCH MATERIAL (Equations S1-S2)
# Attenuation factor derived by comparing incident sunlight irradiance to
# sunlight irradiance after passing through the pouch material.
# -> Figure S2
# ============================================================================

## 2a. Read the pouch-vs-sunlight radiometer test data -----------------------
radiometer_test_data <- dir_ls("Data/Radiometer Test", regexp = "\\.csv$") %>%
  map_df(function(file) {
    filename <- path_file(file) %>% str_remove("\\.csv$")
    parts <- str_split(filename, "_")[[1]]
    read_tsv(file, skip = 10,
             col_names = c("wavelength_nm", "irradiance_W_m2"),
             col_types = "dd") %>%
      mutate(
        irradiance_W_m2 = irradiance_W_m2 / 100,  # Convert from uW/cm2 to W/m2
        date = parts[3],
        material = parts[2],
        filename = filename,
        .before = wavelength_nm
      )
  })

## 2b. Equation S1: per-wavelength attenuation factor ------------------------
attenuation_adjustment <- radiometer_test_data %>%
  group_by(material, wavelength_nm) %>%
  summarise(irradiance_W_m2 = mean(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = material, values_from = irradiance_W_m2) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_diff = ((pouch - sunlight) / sunlight) * 100,
    attenuation_factor = 1 + percent_diff / 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(wavelength_nm)

print("Attenuation adjustment (per-wavelength percent difference / adjustment factors):")
print(attenuation_adjustment)

## 2c. Apply the attenuation factor to the field measurements to get
##     "Passing Through Pouch" irradiance (used later in Table S1) ----------
uvb_results_attenuation_only <- process_uv(
  radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVB, "UVB",
  attenuation_table = attenuation_adjustment,
  apply_attenuation = TRUE
)
uva_results_attenuation_only <- process_uv(
  radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVA, "UVA",
  attenuation_table = attenuation_adjustment,
  apply_attenuation = TRUE
)

## 2d. Equation S2: percent attenuation averaged across each spectrum
##     (reported in text as 14% UVA / 16.7% UVB) -----------------------------
uv_summary <- bind_rows(
  radiometer_test_data %>%
    filter_wavelength(WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVB) %>%
    group_by(material) %>%
    summarise(irradiance_sum = sum(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(wavelength_range = "UVB"),
  radiometer_test_data %>%
    filter_wavelength(WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVA) %>%
    group_by(material) %>%
    summarise(irradiance_sum = sum(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(wavelength_range = "UVA"),
  radiometer_test_data %>%
    filter_wavelength(WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UV_COMBINED) %>%
    group_by(material) %>%
    summarise(irradiance_sum = sum(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(wavelength_range = "UVA + UVB"),
  radiometer_test_data %>%
    group_by(material) %>%
    summarise(irradiance_sum = sum(irradiance_W_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(wavelength_range = "Total")
)

percent_diff <- uv_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = material, values_from = irradiance_sum) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_diff = round(((pouch - sunlight) / sunlight) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(wavelength_range, pouch, sunlight, percent_diff)

print("Percent difference:")
print(percent_diff)

## 2e. Figure S2: measured irradiance of incident sunlight vs. sunlight
##     passing through the pouch (full spectrum, with UVA+UVB inset) --------
material_labels <- c(
  "pouch" = "Enteral Feeding Pouch",

           xmin = WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UV_COMBINED[1],

           ymin = y_limits$ymin,

plot_uv <- radiometer_test_data %>%
```
