    plot.title = element_text(size = 9)
  )

legend_plot <- ggplot(radiometer_test_data, aes(x = wavelength_nm, y = irradiance_W_m2,
                                                 color = material)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = material_colors, labels = material_labels) +
  labs(color = "Material") +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

extracted_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

Figure_S2 <- (plot_full) /
  ((plot_uv | extracted_legend) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.65, 0.35)))

save_pdf_png(
  plot = Figure_S2,
  path = "Figures/FigureS2.",
  w = 169, h = 110
)

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 3: DEPTH-AVERAGED IRRADIANCE ACCOUNTING FOR LIGHT SCREENING
# Following Anderson & Boehm (2023): a modified Beer's Law light-screening
# factor, from spectrophotometer absorbance data, applied on top of the
# attenuation-adjusted irradiance from Section 2.
# -> Figure S3
# ============================================================================

## 3a. Read spectrophotometer absorbance data --------------------------------
Z_CONSTANT <- 0.058  # estimated pouch depth (m) when full and floating in water
CUVETTE_WIDTH <- 0.01  # cuvette path length (m)

absorbance_data <- suppressWarnings(
  read_csv(
    "Data/Spectrophotometer/PycnoGraham.csv",
    col_names = c("wavelength_nm_raw", "absorbance", "extra"),
    col_types = "ddc",
    skip = 1
  )
) %>%
  # Drop the trailing metadata block: those rows fail to parse as numeric
  # wavelength/absorbance and come through as NA
  select(wavelength_nm_raw, absorbance) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wavelength_nm_raw), !is.na(absorbance)) %>%
  # This instrument doesn't report whole-number wavelengths, so round to
  # the nearest nm to match the radiometer data
  mutate(wavelength_nm = round(wavelength_nm_raw)) %>%
  group_by(wavelength_nm) %>%
  summarise(absorbance = mean(absorbance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(wavelength_nm) %>%
  # Convert raw absorbance to an absorption coefficient by normalizing out
  # the cuvette path length
  mutate(absorption_coefficient = absorbance / CUVETTE_WIDTH)

## 3b. Equation S3: light-screening factor per wavelength (modified Beer's Law)
##     factor = (1 - 10^(-a * z)) / (2.303 * a * z)
##     where a = absorption coefficient (absorbance / cuvette width)
##     NOTE: assuming standard parenthesization of this formula (the
##     well-known self-shading/light-screening correction) -- double check
##     this matches what you intended before relying on the output.
absorption_adjustment <- absorbance_data %>%
  mutate(
    light_screening_factor = (1 - 10^(-absorption_coefficient * Z_CONSTANT)) / (2.303 * absorption_coefficient * Z_CONSTANT)
  )

print("Absorption adjustment (per-wavelength light-screening factors):")
print(absorption_adjustment)

## 3c. Apply attenuation *and* light-screening adjustments sequentially to
##     get "Depth-Averaged within Pouch" irradiance (used in Table S1) ------
uvb_results_adjusted <- process_uv(
  radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVB, "UVB",
  attenuation_table = attenuation_adjustment,
  absorption_table = absorption_adjustment,
  apply_attenuation = TRUE,
  apply_absorption = TRUE
)
uva_results_adjusted <- process_uv(
  radiometer_data, WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UVA, "UVA",
  attenuation_table = attenuation_adjustment,
  absorption_table = absorption_adjustment,
  apply_attenuation = TRUE,
  apply_absorption = TRUE
)

## 3d. Figure S3: measured vs. attenuation-adjusted vs. depth-averaged
##     irradiance by wavelength, for one example measurement ----------------
target_date <- "15Sept2025"  # <-- adjust to match your filename format
target_time <- "0907"        # <-- adjust to match your filename format

spectrum_check <- radiometer_data %>%
  filter(condition == "Light",
         date == target_date,
         time == target_time) %>%
  filter_wavelength(WAVELENGTH_RANGES$UV_COMBINED) %>%
  left_join(attenuation_adjustment %>% select(wavelength_nm, attenuation_factor), by = "wavelength_nm") %>%
  left_join(absorption_adjustment %>% select(wavelength_nm, light_screening_factor), by = "wavelength_nm") %>%
  mutate(
    attenuation_factor = replace_na(attenuation_factor, 1),
    light_screening_factor = replace_na(light_screening_factor, 1),
    `Measured at Surface` = irradiance_W_m2,
    `Passing Through Pouch` = `Measured at Surface` * attenuation_factor,
    `Depth-Averaged within pouch` = `Passing Through Pouch` * light_screening_factor
  )

# Sanity check -- should be one row per wavelength in the UVA + UVB range
nrow(spectrum_check)

spectrum_long <- spectrum_check %>%
  select(wavelength_nm, `Measured at Surface`, `Passing Through Pouch`, `Depth-Averaged within pouch`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Measured at Surface`, `Passing Through Pouch`, `Depth-Averaged within pouch`),
    names_to = "stage",
    values_to = "irradiance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Measured at Surface", "Passing Through Pouch", "Depth-Averaged within pouch")))

stage_colors <- c(
  "Measured at Surface" = "black",
  "Passing Through Pouch" = "grey70",
  "Depth-Averaged within pouch" = "#d62728"
)
stage_linetypes <- c(
  "Measured at Surface" = "solid",
  "Passing Through Pouch" = "dashed",
  "Depth-Averaged within pouch" = "dotted"
)

Figure_S3 <- ggplot(spectrum_long, aes(x = wavelength_nm, y = irradiance,
                                        color = stage, linetype = stage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = stage_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = stage_linetypes) +
  labs(
    x = "Wavelength (nm)",
    y = "Irradiance (W/m\u00b2)",
    color = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Figure_S3

save_pdf_png(
  plot = Figure_S3,
  path = "Figures/FigureS3.",
  w = 169, h = 85
)

# ============================================================================
# TABLE S1: MEASURED AT SURFACE vs. PASSING THROUGH POUCH vs. DEPTH-AVERAGED
# WITHIN POUCH, BY DAY, TREATMENT/CONTROL, AND UV RANGE
# ============================================================================
dir_create("Tables")

## Join the three stages' daily averages for one UV range into one table ----
build_stage_summary <- function(surface_avg, pouch_avg, depth_avg, uv_type) {
  mean_col_surface <- names(surface_avg)[grep("^mean_", names(surface_avg))][1]
  mean_col_pouch   <- names(pouch_avg)[grep("^mean_", names(pouch_avg))][1]
  mean_col_depth   <- names(depth_avg)[grep("^mean_", names(depth_avg))][1]

  surface_avg %>%
    select(date, condition, measured_at_surface = !!sym(mean_col_surface)) %>%
    left_join(
      pouch_avg %>% select(date, condition, passing_through_pouch = !!sym(mean_col_pouch)),
      by = c("date", "condition")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      depth_avg %>% select(date, condition, depth_averaged_within_pouch = !!sym(mean_col_depth)),
      by = c("date", "condition")
    ) %>%
    mutate(uv_type = uv_type)
}

uvb_stage_summary <- build_stage_summary(uvb_results$daily_average, uvb_results_attenuation_only$daily_average, uvb_results_adjusted$daily_average, "UVB")
uva_stage_summary <- build_stage_summary(uva_results$daily_average, uva_results_attenuation_only$daily_average, uva_results_adjusted$daily_average, "UVA")

## Assign "Day 1", "Day 2", ... labels from sorted unique dates, and relabel
## condition Light/Dark as Treatment/Control ---------------------------------
assign_day_labels <- function(stage_summary) {
  date_lookup <- stage_summary %>%
    distinct(date) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(day_label = paste("Day", row_number()))

  stage_summary %>%
    left_join(date_lookup, by = "date") %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = case_when(
        condition == "Light" ~ "Treatment",
        condition == "Dark" ~ "Control",
        TRUE ~ condition
      )
    )
}

uvb_stage_summary <- assign_day_labels(uvb_stage_summary)
uva_stage_summary <- assign_day_labels(uva_stage_summary)

## "Average" row: mean of daily averages across all days, per Treatment/Control
build_average_row <- function(stage_summary) {
  stage_summary %>%
    group_by(group_label) %>%
    summarise(
      measured_at_surface = mean(measured_at_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
      passing_through_pouch = mean(passing_through_pouch, na.rm = TRUE),
      depth_averaged_within_pouch = mean(depth_averaged_within_pouch, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(day_label = "Average")
}

uvb_average_row <- build_average_row(uvb_stage_summary)
uva_average_row <- build_average_row(uva_stage_summary)

## Combine day rows + Average row, Treatment listed before Control each day,
## rounded to 2 decimal places to match the target table --------------------
finalize_table <- function(stage_summary, average_row) {
  day_order <- unique(stage_summary$day_label)

  bind_rows(
    stage_summary %>%
      select(day_label, group_label, measured_at_surface, passing_through_pouch, depth_averaged_within_pouch),
    average_row
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = factor(group_label, levels = c("Treatment", "Control")),
      day_label = factor(day_label, levels = c(day_order, "Average"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(day_label, group_label) %>%
    mutate(across(c(measured_at_surface, passing_through_pouch, depth_averaged_within_pouch), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

uvb_table <- finalize_table(uvb_stage_summary, uvb_average_row) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("UVB_", .), -c(day_label, group_label))
uva_table <- finalize_table(uva_stage_summary, uva_average_row) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("UVA_", .), -c(day_label, group_label))

## Combine UVA and UVB side by side (UVA columns first, matching the larger-
## magnitude left block in the target table -- swap order here if backwards)
summary_table <- uva_table %>%
  left_join(uvb_table, by = c("day_label", "group_label")) %>%
  rename(Day = day_label, Group = group_label)

print("Surface / Pouch / Depth-Averaged summary table:")
print(summary_table)

write_csv(summary_table, "Tables/TableS_SurfacePouchDepth.csv")

## Formatted version of the table (merged header spanners, grouped Day rows,
## bolded Average row) matching the target layout ----------------------------
## Rebuilt with kableExtra (already used for Tables 3 & 4) instead of gt, so
## there's no dependency on gt/its heavier install requirements.

uv_col_labels <- c("Measured at Surface", "Passing Through Pouch",
                    "Depth-Averaged<br>within pouch")

# Row numbers of the "Average" summary rows, so they can be bolded the way
# gt's cells_row_groups(groups = "Average") / cells_stub(rows = ...) did
average_rows <- which(summary_table$Day == "Average")

summary_kable <- summary_table %>%
  select(-Day) %>%  # Day becomes pack_rows() group labels below instead of a column
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group", uv_col_labels, uv_col_labels),
    align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
    escape = FALSE  # allow the <br> line break in the "Depth-Averaged" label
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "UVA" = 3, "UVB" = 3), bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Irradiance (W/m\u00b2)" = 6), bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(average_rows, bold = TRUE)

# Add one Day/"Average" row-group label per block, bolding only the
# "Average" label itself (gt didn't bold the "Day 1", "Day 2", ... labels)
row_cursor <- 1
for (day in as.character(unique(summary_table$Day))) {
  n_rows <- sum(summary_table$Day == day)
  summary_kable <- summary_kable %>%
    pack_rows(
      group_label = day,
      start_row = row_cursor,
      end_row = row_cursor + n_rows - 1,
      bold = (day == "Average")
    )
  row_cursor <- row_cursor + n_rows
}

summary_kable
